review:
Mystery Garden is a peaceful 5x3, 10-line slot set in a secluded garden. Golden scatter keys unlock the free spins greenhouse.

Three or more scatters award 10 free spins. Inside, winning combinations of flowers and initials lock into wooden frames, paying out again on following spins until the bonus runs out, similar to OOF The Goldmine Planet. The free spins can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it low volatility with a 2,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 184 spins. A calming, gentle game.
